mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month year-over-year inflation rate above 5.0% combined with a monthly federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals an aggressive monetary policy response to persistent inflation, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL 12m yoy > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m yoy > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a monthly decline in housing starts exceeding 0.5% signals weakening demand for housing, reducing construction activity and consumer confidence, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST falls > 0.5% in 1 month and the regime is late-cycle expansion or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A level of industrial production above 100 signals strong economic activity that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100 or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly nonfarm payrolls increase exceeding 200,000 jobs signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises > 200.0 in 1 month or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong real consumer spending above 690,000 million combined with high housing starts above 1,450,000 units signals robust demand conditions that support corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 690.0 and HOUST > 1450.0 or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 4.5% signals continued restrictive policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and the regime is monetary tightening cycle or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is above -0.03.
